description: This source file provides functions for managing plugin metadata, including copying plugin directories, rewriting package extension fields, validating paths, and handling plugin skill assets. It contains utilities for the build process related to plugin packaging and distribution for an OpenClaw project.

methods.name: copyBundledPluginMetadata
methods.description: Main exported function that handles copying plugin directories, processing manifests and packages, and cleaning up or generating necessary files for plugin distribution.

methods.name: rewritePackageExtensions
methods.description: Rewrites extension entries in package JSON to replace their file extensions with '.js'.

methods.name: collectTopLevelPublicSurfaceEntries
methods.description: Collects top-level JavaScript/TypeScript files in a plugin directory, filtering out test, config, and snapshot files.

methods.name: isManifestlessBundledRuntimeSupportPackage
methods.description: Determines if a plugin is a runtime support package based on its name and surface entries.

methods.name: rewritePackageEntry
methods.description: Rewrites a package setup entry string to ensure it points to a '.js' file.

methods.name: ensurePathInsideRoot
methods.description: Resolves a path ensuring it stays within a specified root directory, throws error if it escapes.

methods.name: normalizeManifestRelativePath
methods.description: Normalizes file paths in manifest entries, replacing backslashes with slashes and removing leading './'.

methods.name: resolveDeclaredSkillSourcePath
methods.description: Resolves the source path for a plugin skill, handling local paths and node_modules relocation.

methods.name: resolveBundledSkillTarget
methods.description: Determines the output path for a plugin skill, relocating node_modules paths into a bundled directory.

methods.name: isTransientCopyError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a transient file operation error based on error code.

methods.name: copySkillPathWithRetry
methods.description: Copies a skill directory with retries on transient errors.

methods.name: copyDeclaredPluginSkillPaths
methods.description: Copies declared plugin skill directories, handling path normalization and filtering.
